cases.label: Jamois 2003 hexagonal air holes

source.secondary_comparison: ZenBand Figure 4b shading is a separate digitized reference and is not substituted for these original stated edges.

limitations: Infinite lossless 2D material, epsilon=11.6 and r/a=0.43. TE has out-of-plane H; TM has out-of-plane E.
Paper rounded edge values have no supplied statistical uncertainty. Differences are reported without a fabricated acceptance threshold.
Default resolution32 is an initial run; refine resolution and interior k sampling before claiming convergence.

cases.label: Sesame 1D CdS/CdTe author-data comparison

source.reference_conversion: Author A/m2 multiplied by 0.1 to mA/cm2; solver diode_current_A_cm2 multiplied by 1000

limitations: Both contacts are nonselective Ohmic with four velocities1.16e7 cm/s; these contact choices were reconstructed, not uniquely given in the paper.
Uniform generation1e21/3 cm^-3 s^-1 is an inferred unrounded value; printed3.3e20 remains a distinct editable scenario.
360-node mesh is an initial reconstruction. Bias/mesh convergence and contact uncertainty remain separate from author-data agreement.

cases.label: Sesame 2D grain boundary author-data comparison

source.reference_conversion: Author A/m2 multiplied by 0.1 to mA/cm2; solver diode_current_A_cm2 multiplied by 1000
source.energy_reference: Paper +0.4eV above geometric midgap converted to intrinsic-reference energy using Ei shift kT/2 ln(Nv/Nc)

vector_extraction.limitation: Vector path vertices may have been simplified by plotting software; they are not raw simulation samples. Use approximately 5 meV as a conservative graphical comparison scale away from discontinuities; interpolation between sparse vertices adds uncertainty.

limitations: Ohmic contact velocities and unrounded uniform generation are reconstructed assumptions.
Reported current is conservative transverse mean, not the historical Sesame spline integral.
Grain-boundary energy is relative to intrinsic Ei; no hidden fitted energy offset.
Coarse initial mesh; refine both axes and biases. Band reference consists of PDF vector vertices and may omit/simplify interface discontinuities.

cases.label: Cersonsky 2021 direct diamond

source.coordinate_conversion: Author sphere centers +/-[1/8,1/8,1/8] in fractional primitive coordinates converted to Cartesian via lattice rows.

limitations: Frequency normalization uses primitive-vector length, not conventional cubic-cell edge.
14.74% is the paper reported gap/midgap ratio; no unreported edge frequencies or acceptance tolerance invented.
The supplied path is a standard FCC path. Original redundant author path was unavailable. Interior k-grid and resolution convergence remain required.
Initial resolution16 is not converged. Duplicate this case and use parameter_sweep to explore editable radii, material values and lattice vectors.

cases.label: Yang 2021 air-hole vertical QW overlap

source.title: Simulation of Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Lasers with Air-Hole and Air-Pillar Structures
source.calibration_source: Recovered PDF vector-path axis calibration, reproduced from the saved study build_report.py; no fitted material or geometry parameters.
source.extracted_coordinate: Air filling fraction f and normalized QW intensity overlap
source.reference_interpolation: Linear interpolation of extracted vertices at f=0.16, within their domain

limitations: Passive area-averaged vertical optical model. Layer thicknesses and refractive indices follow Tables1-2.
Lower AlGaAs cladding is continued into a semi-infinite medium; unspecified substrate is a modeling assumption.
Reference is extracted from plotted PDF vector vertices, not author raw output; no invented statistical tolerance.
A single f=0.16 point does not establish full sweep agreement. Vertical spacing/padding convergence remain separate.

cases.label: Yang 2021 air-hole RIT finite 200um slope

source.title: Simulation of Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Lasers with Air-Hole and Air-Pillar Structures
source.calibration_source: Recovered PDF vector-path axis calibration, reproduced from the saved study build_report.py; no fitted material or geometry parameters.
source.extracted_coordinate: Square cavity length and plotted A0 slope-efficiency curve
source.reference_interpolation: Linear interpolation of extracted vertices at L=200um, within their domain

limitations: Conditional passive-optics slope estimate: hc/q=1240nm V, injection efficiency1, upward radiation fraction0.5 and internal loss5cm^-1, following the saved paper-equation reconstruction.
No threshold-current, nonlinear L-I, transport or heating prediction follows from this estimate.
Current adapter uses a layer-resolved radiation Green function; older saved study used optical-path approximation for pillars. Differences remain visible.
Lowest-loss eligible returned sparse mode is used; the global lowest-loss mode is not proven. Refine Fourier harmonics, collocation order and mode search.
Reference is a PDF vector curve, not author raw output; no fabricated acceptance tolerance.
